backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor defining data types (Resume, UserProfile, JobRole, Skills, Education, WorkExperience) and implementing resume validation, analysis, scoring, job role management, and user profile operations with authorization mixins and blob storage integration.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report documenting four high-confidence features: comprehensive AI resume parsing, enhanced work experience extraction, resume scoring/analysis system, and modern UI redesign with their associated files, components, and test IDs.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Comprehensive summaries of all frontend components including routing, authentication, admin panels, resume upload/analysis workflows, data visualization charts, and UI components with their specific functionalities and integrations.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom CSS variables for light and dark themes, defining color schemes for UI elements including primary, secondary, accent, destructive colors, charts, and sidebar components.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point for the React application with viewport configuration and root div mounting point for the TypeScript module.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root application component configuring TanStack Router with routes for home, analysis flow, dashboard, admin panel, resume upload/results, implementing authentication checks, profile setup modal, and theme provider.
frontend/src/components/AccessDeniedScre: Access denied screen component displaying a shield alert icon and message for unauthorized users attempting to access admin-restricted pages with navigation back to home.
frontend/src/components/AdminGuard.tsx: Higher-order component that checks admin permissions via useIsCallerAdmin hook and conditionally renders children for authorized admins or AccessDeniedScreen for unauthorized users.
frontend/src/components/ConfirmDeleteDia: AlertDialog component for confirming resume deletion with resume name display, cancel/confirm actions, and loading state support during deletion operation.
frontend/src/components/DownloadReportBu: Button component that generates and downloads personalized PDF analysis reports using pdfGenerator service with job role, skills, recommendations, and resume context data.
frontend/src/components/GapAnalysisResul: Displays skill gap analysis results in a two-column card layout showing matching skills (with green styling) and missing/insufficient proficiency skills (with red/yellow styling), categorized by technical and soft skills with color-coded proficiency badges.
frontend/src/components/JobRoleForm.tsx: Form component for creating or updating job roles with title, description, and dynamic skill list management; validates input and uses React Query mutations to persist changes with toast notifications.
frontend/src/components/JobRoleMatchResu: Displays a list of job role compatibility results sorted by match percentage, showing each role's compatibility score, matching/missing skill counts, and a button to view detailed gap analysis.
Radio group component that fetches and displays available job roles with their required skills as selectable cards, handling loading states and empty states appropriately.
frontend/src/components/Layout.tsx: Main application layout with sticky header navigation, authentication-aware menu items (including admin-only routes), mobile responsive menu, and logo branding.
frontend/src/components/LoginButton.tsx: Authentication button component that handles Internet Identity login/logout with loading states and query cache clearing on logout.
frontend/src/components/ProficiencyGapCh: Bar chart visualization component using Recharts to display the distribution of matching vs missing skills across beginner, intermediate, and advanced proficiency levels.
frontend/src/components/ProfileSetupModa: Modal dialog for initial user profile setup, collecting name (required), email, education, and experience fields, then saving via useSaveCallerUserProfile hook.
frontend/src/components/RecommendationsD: Displays personalized learning recommendations for missing skills, showing recommended courses with external links and practice projects for each skill gap.
frontend/src/components/ResumeList.tsx: Lists uploaded resumes with metadata (skills, experience, education counts), supports selection and deletion with confirmation dialog, and handles loading/empty states.
frontend/src/components/ResumeUpload.tsx: Handles PDF resume upload with validation, parses content using NLP service, extracts skills, validates required sections (experience, skills, education), and converts to backend format before uploading.
frontend/src/components/SkillCategoryCha: Bar chart component displaying matching vs missing skills grouped by category (Technical and Soft Skills) using recharts.
Pie chart component visualizing the proportion of matching skills versus missing skills using recharts.
Displays skills grouped by category (Technical, Soft, Domain) as colored badges with proficiency level indicators (beginner, intermediate, advanced).
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: React Query hook that creates and manages the backend actor instance based on Internet Identity authentication state, initializing access control with admin token and invalidating dependent queries on actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: React hook and provider for Internet Identity authentication on ICP, managing login state, identity persistence, and delegation validation with configurable AuthClient options.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: React Query hooks for backend API calls including user profiles, admin checks, job roles (CRUD operations), and resume management with automatic cache invalidation.
frontend/src/hooks/useResumeAnalysis.ts: React Query mutation hook that orchestrates resume analysis by parsing with AI, saving extracted data to backend, and uploading the file blob with progress tracking.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom design tokens defining a warm, education-focused color palette (coral primary, teal secondary, amber accent) for both light and dark modes.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that sets up React root with QueryClient for data fetching and InternetIdentityProvider for authentication context.
frontend/src/pages/AdminPanel.tsx: Admin-only page for managing job roles with CRUD operations, displaying required skills with proficiency badges, and confirmation dialogs for deletions.
frontend/src/pages/AnalysisDashboard.tsx: Dashboard page displaying comprehensive resume analysis results including skill matching, gap analysis, recommendations, and charts, with validation and error handling for missing data.
frontend/src/pages/AnalysisFlow.tsx: Main analysis flow page that handles resume upload/selection, skill extraction, job role matching, and displays match results with tabs for upload vs. select modes.
frontend/src/pages/HomePage.tsx: Landing page with hero section and feature cards explaining the four-step process: upload resume, select job role, get analysis, and receive recommendations.
frontend/src/pages/ResumeResultsPage.tsx: Admin-only page displaying comprehensive resume analysis results including resume score, categorized skills, work experience, education, and contact information with progress indicators.
frontend/src/pages/ResumeUploadPage.tsx: Admin-only page with drag-and-drop file upload interface for resumes (PDF/images), validates file size/type, shows upload progress, and navigates to results page on success.
frontend/src/services/aiResumeParser.ts: Service that converts uploaded resume files to bytes and calls NLP service to extract comprehensive structured data including contact info, skills, experience, and education.
frontend/src/services/gapAnalysis.ts: Performs skill gap analysis by comparing resume skills against job role requirements, identifying missing skills, matching skills, and insufficient proficiency skills with context validation.
frontend/src/services/nlpService.ts: Defines types for resume data (comprehensive, parsed, work experience, education, certifications) and provides functions to extract text from PDF bytes, parse contact info, professional summaries, and other resume sections using pattern matching and text analysis.
frontend/src/services/pdfGenerator.ts: Generates downloadable text-based skill gap analysis reports including job role match percentage, matching/missing skills, personalized recommendations, and candidate profile data (experience, education, certifications) formatted for download as a blob.
frontend/src/services/recommendationEngi: Provides personalized course and project recommendations for skill gaps using hardcoded databases mapping skills (JavaScript, Python, React, SQL, ML, Docker, Kubernetes) to relevant courses from Udemy/Coursera/freeCodeCamp and suggested practice projects.
frontend/src/services/resumeScoring.ts: Calculates a comprehensive resume score (0-100) across four dimensions: completeness (name, contact, experience, education, skills), content quality (experience duration, career progression), formatting, and skill relevance, returning scores with detailed feedback for each criterion.
frontend/src/services/skillExtraction.ts: Extracts and categorizes skills from parsed resume data into technical, soft, and domain categories using a predefined technical skills database, and calculates experience level (entry/mid/senior/expert) and total years of experience from work history durations.
frontend/src/services/skillMatching.ts: Implements skill matching algorithms that compare resume skills against job role requirements, calculating match percentages and identifying matching/missing skills with proficiency level consideration.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Provides utility functions for extracting, storing, and managing URL parameters from both query strings and hash-based routing, with sessionStorage persistence support.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration defining custom color schemes using OKLCH color space, typography, animations, and design tokens for a modern UI system.
project_state.json: Project metadata tracking implemented features including comprehensive resume data extraction, work experience parsing, skills/education/certifications extraction, resume scoring, and UI redesign.
